value.name: Charlene questions Micky's absence from work
value.description: Charlene confronts Micky about why he is not at work and whether ESPN is paying him to train.
evidence:
CHARLENE
Why aren't you at work? Is ESPN
paying you to train?

value.name: Micky says Dicky is handling work
value.description: Micky answers that Dicky is handling his job responsibilities.

value.name: Charlene criticizes Dicky as a handler
value.description: Charlene dismisses Dicky and suggests Alice would be a better choice to handle things.
evidence:
CHARLENE
Dicky? Alice would be better than
Dicky.

value.name: Micky urges Kasie to jump
value.description: Micky, acting as coach, tells Kasie to attempt the high jump while noting her patience.
evidence:
MICKY
(OS)
Would you jump for Chrissakes?
Kasie's bein' very patient.

value.name: Micky and Kasie set up high jump attempt
value.description: Micky and Kasie hold a bamboo stick as a makeshift high jump bar over pillows on the lawn.
evidence:
MICKY, IN RUNNING CLOTHES, HOLDS ONE END OF AN
OLD BAMBOO GARDEN STICK, 5' ACROSS, LIKE A HIGH JUMP BAR; HIS
DAUGHTER KASIE, 10, HOLDS THE OTHER END, A PILE OF tattered
chez pillows on the lawn beneath it.

value.name: Kasie worries about the jump setup
value.description: Kasie suggests the jump may be too difficult because there are not enough cushions.
evidence:
KASIE
Maybe it's too hard for her. Maybe
there's not enough cushions.

value.name: Micky reminds Charlene of her past jump height
value.description: Micky says the bar is only 5'1" and reminds Charlene that she once cleared 5'8" as a champion.
evidence:
MICKY
It's only 5'1", she did 5'8" as a
champ, right Charlene? 5'8"?

value.name: Charlene clears the high jump
value.description: Charlene runs a curve and successfully leaps backward over the 5'1" bar onto the pillows.
evidence:
Charlene jogs a little curve to the bar and LEAPS backwards,
clearing 5'1," landing on the pillows.

value.name: Micky and Kasie celebrate the jump
value.description: Micky and Kasie cheer after Charlene clears the bar, and Micky claps with Kasie.
evidence:
MICKY AND KASIE
Yes!
He claps with Kasie

value.name: Charlene jokes about the pillows
value.description: Charlene stands up rubbing herself and jokes that the pillows barely protected her, apologizing to Kasie for the language.
evidence:
Charlene stands rubbing her ass.
CHARLENE
Fuck, those pillows barely did the
job, pardon my French, Kasie.

value.name: Micky leaves with Kasie for dinner
value.description: Micky tells Kasie they need to go home because he has a business dinner with Nana.
evidence:
MICKY
Hey, we gotta get you home Kasie, I
gotta business dinnah with Nana.
